findings.title: UtilEnergyConsumptionResponse toe_total accounts for 6 keys but by_category only returns 5
findings.detail: summary_service.summarize computes toe_total from 6 categories: ELECTRICITY + STEAM_HP + STEAM_MP + STEAM_LP + CONDENSATE + FUEL_GAS (per TOE_FUEL_TYPE_BY_CATEGORY; CONDENSATE→STEAM). /util/energy-consumption filters by_category to a hardcoded set {ELECTRICITY, STEAM_HP, STEAM_MP, STEAM_LP, FUEL_GAS} that excludes CONDENSATE. Consumers verifying toe_total ≈ f(by_category) will silently fail. Either include CONDENSATE in the filter set, or recompute toe_total on the filtered subset.
findings.fix: Add UtilityCategory.CONDENSATE.value to energy_keys set at util.py:208-214 OR subtract CONDENSATE's contribution from toe_total before returning.

findings.title: EquipListBulkSyncResponse.failed typed as list[dict], not a structured schema
findings.detail: failed is declared `list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list, description='失败条目：{ entry, error_code, error_message }')`. Persist_service emits {entry, error_code, error_message}, but the schema accepts arbitrary dicts. OpenAPI emits `additionalProperties: true` and frontend api.d.ts resolves to `{[key: string]: unknown}[]` — full loss of type safety. Consumers have no compile-time signal when the persisted shape drifts.
findings.fix: Define `class EquipListBulkSyncFailedEntry(BaseModel): entry: dict; error_code: str; error_message: str` and use `list[EquipListBulkSyncFailedEntry]`.

findings.title: UtilResultsResponse.consumption_json typed as bare dict, but request is dict[str, float]
findings.detail: Request validates `dict[str, float]` (line 28-31). Response declares bare `dict (line 42)` with no value-type constraint. summary_service raises if a value is non-numeric, so the asymmetry is in the schema only — runtime is float. Frontend receives `generated: any` instead of `Record<string, number>`. Mismatched contract surface invites schema drift on either side.

findings.title: EquipListListFilter schema defined but never referenced
findings.detail: Class is defined but never imported in any router, never used as response_model or in Query() FastAPI deps. list_equipment builds its own Query() params directly (equip_list.py:74-82). Either dead code (delete) or aspirational (wire it via Depends()). Currently bloats the OpenAPI surface.
findings.fix: Delete the class, or use it as a Depends() to consolidate filter param validation.

findings.title: UtilWaterBalanceResponse hardcodes year=2026, no year query param unlike sibling endpoints
findings.detail: Siblings /util/summary and /util/energy-consumption accept `year` Query (ge=2020, le=2100). /util/water-balance hardcodes year=2026 in the response and does not accept year. Comment in code: 'water 无 TOE 年份依赖' — but the response still emits a year field, so the year is meaningful for the consumer even if unused internally. Inconsistent surface.
findings.fix: Either remove `year` from response, or accept year Query and pass through.

findings.title: UtilEnergySummaryResponse.tolerance_status is required str without enum
findings.detail: Field is `tolerance_status: str` (required). Model derives it from computed tolerance_pct; downstream code likely uses 2-3 states (PASS/WARN/FAIL etc.). Without a Literal or Enum constraint, contract drift is silent.
findings.fix: Replace with `Literal['PASS', 'WARN', 'FAIL']` (or actual values) once tokens are pinned.

findings.title: source_module enum differs between endpoints (sync=8, aggregator=4)
findings.detail: EquipListSyncRequest allows PUMP/VESSEL/HEAT/PSV/CV/COOL_TOWER/PSYCHRO/OPEN_CHANNEL (8); UtilAggregationRequest allows PUMP/HEAT/COOL_TOWER/OPEN_CHANNEL (4). Intentional per source_aggregator design (only 4 modules feed consumption_json). Documented in source comments. Documented in matched literals for both.
findings.fix: None — confirmed intentional. Consider adding the discrepancy to API docs.

findings.title: annual_consumption_* fields default to derived value when request omits
findings.detail: POST /util/power-items, /util/fuel-gas-items, /heat-exchange-items all derive annual_consumption_* server-side when client omits. Response always includes the computed value as required non-nullable float. Additive contract — no client-side breakage.

findings.title: All 19 new endpoints reachable via /api/v1
findings.detail: equip_list_router (line 12 import, line 59 include) → 4 endpoints under /api/v1/equipment-list*. util_router (line 38 import, line 72 include) → 15 endpoints under /api/v1/util/*. Both routers included exactly once.

findings.title: No SemVer bump despite new public surface
findings.detail: All endpoints added under existing /api/v1 prefix without version increment. Additive-only changes are SemVer-compatible per the repo's existing pattern (prior P6 batches followed the same convention). Frontend openapi.snapshot.json was regenerated and matches backend.
